title: It's just ok.
text: It's just ok.. The pan is very lightweight so I doubt it will last long but it's working alright for now.

product_metadata.title: Calphalon 1932337 Classic Nonstick Everyday Chef Pan with Cover, 12", Grey
features: Dual-layer nonstick for easy food release, and quick cleanup
description: The Calphalon classic nonstick 12-Inch everyday pan is made with dual-layer nonstick for extra-easy food release and cleanup, and constructed from durable hard-anodized aluminum for fast and even heating. With its versatile shape and size, This shallow nonstick pan is great for stovetop-to-oven and one-pot meals with beautiful stainless steel loop handles so it fits easily in the oven. Includes oven-safe tempered glass lid to help foods retain moisture when cooking.
